answer: Re-attestations are stored in glacier and comet lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the knoll graph. A farm of 2103 identities would post 4451 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
